findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Usage of random and threading
 * @description Find usages of random and threading modules to understand their purpose
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/debug-random-threading
 * @tags debug
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "randrange", "choice", "shuffle", "sample"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("threading").getMember(["Lock", "RLock", "Semaphore", "BoundedSemaphore", "Event", "Condition", "Thread"]).getACall()
select call, "Usage of random or threading."
findings.hypothesis: Check for usage of random and threading to identify potential weak PRNG or race conditions.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Improper Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
 * @description Modifying object attributes with user-controlled names can lead to unexpected behavior.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-dynamic-attribute-modification
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-915
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["setattr", "getattr", "delattr"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to dynamic attribute function."
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic attribute modification can lead to object tampering.
